method: Read saved JSON/NPZ/Python files on Windows; recompute each cache oracle from before-cache, source arrays and indices independently of the harness verifier. No WSL or GPU execution.
source_difference: Candidate AST equals coach template after normalizing NUM_WARPS 1 to 4. Accepted shared kernel remains pinned.
launch_review: Each nonempty case has exactly one recorded launch with grid=[B], correct WIDTH/source stride/cache stride/BLOCK_SIZE, frozen_v1 num_warps=4 or candidate num_warps=1. Each empty case has no recorded KV launch.

scope.configuration_policy: 14 selected layout configurations across seven batch sizes, not the complete Cartesian product

limitations: This experiment compares two Triton launch configurations; it does not rerun the original CUDA operator.
No timing or speedup claim is supported.
B=16 and B=256 timing inputs are absent and must be checked before those performance comparisons.
Recorded launch parameters are evidence of submitted configuration; this audit did not inspect compiler output or hardware counters.
Finite deterministic values, selected valid unique indices and selected layouts only. No arbitrary-stride, NaN/Inf or unrestricted-width claim.
Array equality and source mask review do not prove absence of all invalid memory reads.
Invalid-call records preserve visible tensors rather than proving all hidden backing bytes; successful valid-call NPZ checks cover their full allocated backing.
Engineering correctness does not establish independent learner mastery.
acceptance_recommendation: Accept M07-04 correctness for the stated matrix and sole NUM_WARPS 4-to-1 change. Proceed to same-policy paired timing only after validating the timing configurations; leave learning mastery and performance acceptance separate.
